_comment: Item catalogue. Ship parts (part:<material>:<fn>:<piece>) and ship plans (plan:<blueprint>) are generated from the ship catalogue and blueprint library, not listed here. value = base credits; volume = cargo space per unit (default 1).

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Common ore found in almost every belt. Alloyed into plate.

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.description: Common ore. Alloyed with iron into hull plating.

items.name: Silicate
items.description: Rocky silica. Pressed into composites and lenses.

items.name: Water Ice
items.description: Frozen volatiles. Used in composites, coolant and boost cells.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Drawn into wiring for generators, thrusters and guns.

items.name: Titanium Ore
items.description: Hard ore: it needs a strong mining laser. Refined into light, tough plate.

items.name: Cobalt Ore
items.description: Ore from dangerous belts. Refined into cobalt superalloy.

items.name: Neutronium Ore
items.description: Ore from the Void and the Maw. Refined into Mk V plating.

items.name: Resonant Crystal
items.description: Crystal ore from Glasswater. Focuses beams and stores charge.

items.name: Ruby
items.description: A red gem from glowing seams. Valuable to traders.

items.name: Sapphire
items.description: A blue gem from seams in cold belts. Valuable to traders.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: A rare green gem. Valuable to traders.

items.name: Void Opal
items.description: A gem. Only the hardest mining tools crack it free. Very valuable.

items.name: Helium-3
items.description: Fusion fuel skimmed from comet tails and gas giants.

items.name: Ferrite Ore
items.description: Dense iron ore, thickest in the Maw. Refined into ferrite plate.

items.name: Chromite
items.description: Chromium ore. Hardens steel for railgun barrels and armour-piercing slugs.

items.name: Aurum
items.description: A trace metal found by refining copper ore. A very good conductor.

items.name: Pale Iridium
items.description: A trace metal found by refining ice and volatile ore. Very dense; stops radiation.

items.name: Platinoid Ore
items.description: Platinum-group ore from the Void. Refined into catalyst, for seeker missiles and torpedoes.

items.name: Voidglass
items.description: A trace glass found by refining crystal ore, richest in gem seams.

items.name: Hydrazine Slush
items.description: Frozen fuel from ice bodies, thickest in Borealis. Refined into propellant.

items.name: Aurora Rime
items.description: Ice from the aurora floes of the Rime Shoal. Refined into hush panes.

items.name: Polymer Precursor
items.description: Tarry hydrocarbons from the nebula bands. Cured into insulated polymer.

items.name: Cryo Gas
items.description: Siphoned from drifting gas pockets, not mined. Refined into cryogen, for chaff canisters and cryo missiles.

items.name: Singularity Dust
items.description: A trace material found by refining the mega rocks of the Maw and the Void.

items.name: Frost Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Hits chill (0.3 a hit): a chilled-through ship seizes up for a moment. −15% damage.

items.name: Frost Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Hits chill (0.6 a hit). −15% damage.

items.name: Ember Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Hits set the part burning. −20% rate of fire.

items.name: Ember Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Hits set the part (and its neighbours) burning. −20% rate of fire.

items.name: Splitter Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Shots shatter into 2 shards on a hit. −30% range.

items.name: Splitter Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Shots shatter into 3 shards on a hit. −30% range.

items.name: Lance Core Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +25% range. Beams run 50% hotter.

items.name: Lance Core Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +40% range, and shots pierce one more. Beams run 50% hotter.

items.name: Grapple Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Shots drag ships near them in. −25% shot speed.

items.name: Grapple Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: Shots drag ships in hard. −25% shot speed.

items.name: Scatter Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +1 shot a volley. Wider spread.

items.name: Scatter Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +2 shots a volley. Wider spread.

items.name: Keel Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +15% part HP. −10% damage.

items.name: Keel Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +25% part HP. −10% damage.

items.name: Sight Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: −10% spread. −10% rate of fire.

items.name: Sight Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: −20% spread. −10% rate of fire.

items.name: Overdrive Gem I
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +15% rate of fire. Beams run 40% hotter.

items.name: Overdrive Gem II
items.description: For a weapon's socket: +25% rate of fire. Beams run 40% hotter.

items.name: Alloy Plate
items.description: Standard hull plating. Iron and nickel.

items.name: Steel Plate
items.description: Mk II plating stock.

items.name: Composite Sheet
items.description: Light pressed silicate and resin.

items.name: Titanium Plate
items.description: Mk III plating stock: light and very tough.

items.name: Copper Wiring
items.description: Power runs. Every working part needs some.

items.name: Crystal Lens
items.description: Focuses beam weapons and scanners.

items.name: Cobalt Superalloy
items.description: Mk IV plating stock, and reactors and heavy cores.

items.name: Neutronium Plate
items.description: Mk V plating stock: the toughest there is.

items.name: Coolant
items.description: Chilled ice. Used in flak canisters, ceramic laminate and gem cutting.

items.name: Dense Ferrite Plate
items.description: Mass-anchor plating: the slowest hull there is, and nothing tosses it.

items.name: Hardened Steel
items.description: Steel hardened with chromium. Used in tungsten railgun slugs.

items.name: Aurum Ingot
items.description: Refined aurum. Used in conductive steel and aurum-tipped slugs, and to cut Ember, Grapple, Scatter and Overdrive gems.

items.name: Iridium Ingot
items.description: Refined pale iridium. Used in leaded iridium plating and to cut Lance Core gems.

items.name: Catalyst
items.description: Refined from platinoid ore. Used in seeker missiles and torpedoes.

items.name: Voidglass Pane
items.description: A rigid laminate. Used in ceramic and sealed composite plating, and to cut Frost and Splitter gems.

items.name: Hush Pane
items.description: Aurora rime pressed into a pane. Borealis Research buys them.

items.name: Propellant
items.description: Fuel for missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells, mining charges and incendiary flak.

items.name: Insulated Polymer
items.description: Insulating hull plating: a hull of it builds up cold slower. Turns energy fire, but heat goes through it.

items.name: Cryogen
items.description: Refined cryo gas. Used in chaff canisters and cryo missiles.

items.name: Singularity Grain
items.description: Refined singularity dust. Rare and valuable.

items.name: Conductive Steel Plate
items.description: Steel alloyed with aurum: guns mounted in it recharge 15% faster.

items.name: Leaded Iridium Plate
items.description: Radiation plating: slow, heavy, and nearly proof against the Void.

items.name: Ceramic Laminate
items.description: Heat plating for Cinder and near-star work. Brittle: collisions hurt it double.

items.name: Sealed Composite Plate
items.description: Corrosion plating for the nebula bands. Costly to repair.

items.name: Scrap Electronics
items.description: Salvaged boards and cracked cores. Every wreck has some.

items.name: Servo Motor
items.description: Drives turret rings and tractor arms.

items.name: Targeting Chip
items.description: Fire control for advanced weapons.

items.name: Power Coupling
items.description: Carries heavy current. Cores and shield generators.

items.name: Shield Emitter
items.description: Projects a deflector field.

items.name: Navigation Computer
items.description: Plots jumps and drives scanners.

items.name: Quantum Core
items.description: The heart of capital-class cores.

items.name: Void Ichor
items.description: Dropped by wraiths.

items.name: Frost Gland
items.description: Cryo organ from the Frost Brood.

items.name: Cinder Ash
items.description: Ash from the Cinder Cult's altars. Used to make the Cinder Bloom.

items.name: Barrel Assembly
items.description: A rifled barrel on a servo mount: cannons, autocannons, flak and mortars.

items.name: Coil Winding
items.description: Copper wound on a ferrite core: railguns, arc and EMP projectors, jump coils.

items.name: Capacitor Cell
items.description: A fast-discharge cell: batteries, capacitors, pulse guns and lasers.

items.name: Thrust Nozzle
items.description: A ceramic-lined titanium bell: torches, plasma and fusion drives.

items.name: Fuel Injector
items.description: Meters propellant into a burn: afterburners and torches.

items.name: Reactor Core
items.description: The heart of a generator past the cell reactor.

items.name: Wire Spool
items.description: Insulated power wire: one spool lays four segments of wiring.

items.name: Rustjaw's Cog
items.description: A drive cog from Rustjaw. A rare drop; Rustjaw's Hive can't be made without it.

items.name: Heart of Hoarfrost
items.description: A core from the Hoarfrost Matriarch's wreck. A rare drop; the Frostbite Lance can't be made without it.

items.name: Warden's Ember
items.description: A coal from the Warden or the Pyreclast. A rare drop; the Cinder Bloom can't be made without it.

items.name: Prism Shard
items.description: A shard from the Prism Colossus. A rare drop; the Prism Splitter can't be made without it.

items.name: Void Pearl
items.description: A pearl from the Void Leviathan's wreck. A rare drop; the Phase Cannon can't be made without it.

items.name: Fragment of the Maw
items.description: A fragment of the Heart of the Maw. A rare drop; the Singularity Launcher can't be made without it.

items.name: Ancient Relic
items.description: A small sealed case. Sells to collectors and fabricators.

items.name: Basic Repair Kit
items.description: Slowly patches your ship: damaged parts first, then missing ones, up to 150 cr of repairs. Hold still: moving or taking a hit wastes what's left.

items.name: Field Repair Kit
items.description: A crate of plate and servo arms: repairs damaged parts, then rebuilds missing ones, up to 500 cr of repairs. Hold still: moving or taking a hit wastes what's left.

items.name: Nanite Repair Kit
items.description: A swarm of repair nanites: heals and regrows your ship fast, up to 1,600 cr of repairs. Hold still: moving or taking a hit wastes what's left.

items.name: Boost Cell
items.description: Refills your boost tank.

items.name: Insurance Bond
items.description: Pays the rebuild bill once after your ship is destroyed.

items.name: Scanner Charge
items.description: One long-range scan pulse, even without a scanner part.

items.name: Railgun Slugs
items.description: A crate of 200 slugs for a railgun (a volley a slug). Made at any fabricator.

items.name: Flak Canisters
items.description: A crate of 120 canisters for a flak gun. Made at any fabricator.

items.name: Missiles
items.description: A crate of 24 missiles for a missile rack. Made at any fabricator.

items.name: Sabot Slugs
items.description: Railgun slugs that punch through one more part, for 25% less damage. 200 a crate.

items.name: Tungsten Slugs
items.description: Heavy railgun slugs: 40% more damage, but only 100 a crate.

items.name: Aurum-tipped Slugs
items.description: Railgun slugs tipped in aurum: 25% more damage. Costly. 200 a crate.

items.name: Quench Slugs
items.description: Railgun slugs with a cryogen core: 30% less damage, but 2.5 times that against Cinder Cult ships (not their great ones). 200 a crate. Pressed only by your own station's armoury.

items.name: Incendiary Canisters
items.description: Flak that sets what it hits burning, for 30% less damage. 120 a crate.

items.name: Chaff Canisters
items.description: Flak that bursts in a short EMP: no damage at all, but it seizes up what it catches. 120 a crate.

items.name: Frag Canisters
items.description: Flak with a wider blast. 120 a crate.

items.name: Shaped-charge Missiles
items.description: Missiles that punch rather than blast: 30% more damage on what they hit, a tighter blast. 24 a crate.

items.name: Seeker Missiles
items.description: Missiles that turn twice as hard to follow their target, for 30% less damage. 24 a crate.

items.name: Cryo Missiles
items.description: Missiles that chill what they hit (two seize it up), for half the damage. 24 a crate.

items.name: Torpedoes
items.description: A crate of 6 torpedoes for a torpedo tube.

items.name: Mortar Shells
items.description: A crate of 40 shells for a mortar.

items.name: Mining Charges
items.description: A crate of 30 charges for a mining charge launcher.

items.name: High-velocity Shells
items.description: Cannon shells that fly 50% faster. 150 a crate. A cannon fires its own plain shells without them.

items.name: Fractured Plating
items.description: A slab of the Kestrel's hull. Dr. Osei wants it.

items.name: Foundry Log
items.description: The Shattered Bell's cargo manifest and a foreman's notes, from the old Halcyon foundry.

items.name: Crucible Pattern
items.description: Pell's drawings for a field crucible.

items.name: Field Crucible
items.description: A portable crucible for making steel. Dr. Osei's experiment.

items.name: Probe Core
items.description: The memory core of one of Sabine Kerr's listening probes.

items.name: Relay Drone Core
items.description: The core of a Scrapborn relay drone. The Sentinel Watch yard wants it.

items.name: Smuggler's Cache
items.description: A sealed cargo cache from the Lanes. The Patrol will want to inspect it.

items.name: Vigil's Log
items.description: The Dreadnought Vigil's bridge log, pulled from the wreck.

items.name: Drowned Beacon
items.description: A landing beacon dug out of the Pale Reef on Terra Nova.

items.name: Buoy Frame
items.description: A nav buoy's base ring and keel.

items.name: Buoy Mast
items.description: A nav buoy's mast.

items.name: Buoy Power Cell
items.description: A pair of power cells for a nav buoy.

items.name: Buoy Transponder Dish
items.description: A nav buoy's dish and transponder.

items.name: Halvard's Log
items.description: The flight log of the Lighter Halvard, an early colony lander lost on the ice road.

items.name: Halden Cache
items.description: A small sealed case of slate, cut out of the ice under Glacia.

items.name: Leestone Ore
items.description: A dark, dense stone. Found in traces in rock across the cluster, thickest in the Maw's shard ring. Refined into leestone.

items.name: Leestone
items.description: Refined leestone. Made into leestone plate.

items.name: Leestone Plate
items.description: Hull plating: leestone faced on a steel backing. Heavy.

items.name: Ark Old Stock
items.description: A crate of retired machinery from the Ark Depot: pump housings, coil packs, a core cradle.

items.name: Directorate Power Cell
items.description: A pallet of Helios Directorate power cells, for the Seat.

items.name: Dock Performance Logs
items.description: A Helios service dock's weekly performance logs. Engineer Rask wants them.

items.name: Drone Service Log
items.description: A month of one Helios drone's service log.

items.name: Kerr's Recorder
items.description: One of Sabine Kerr's listening recorders. She wants it back with half a minute of the Helios Array recorded on it.
